messages:
Maya P: Quick heads-up — ACME asked for a bespoke onboarding SLA: guaranteed model pin for 9 months, weekly benchmark reports, and a migration credit. We need to decide if this becomes a standard offering or a paid addon. Thoughts?
Alex R: my take: 9 months pinned is an ops+cost commitment. should be an add-on or enterprise-only. happy to see numbers.
Samir K: from infra side: keeping pins means maintaining older kernel/quant paths and possibly extra GPU pools. rough ballpark: +15-25% footprint depending on model family.
Irene L: we should formalize "adoptability criteria" so pins aren't ad-hoc. define pass/fail gates (latency, embedding drift, quality delta), pin TTL tiers, and migration playbooks.
Jose M: ACME will want it in contract. sales pressure high. proposing a compromise: 3-mo pinned grace (included) + option to buy extended pin + migration credits.
Samir K: to make engineering commitments measurable, propose technical criteria:
```
- latency: p99 <= target_latency + 20%
- embedding drift: cosine similarity drop <= 0.02 vs baseline
- eval-quality: relative metric delta <= 1% on acceptance suite
- storage/kv: no incompatible format changes during pin window
```
Irene L: +1. Also add operational requirements: who owns rollbacks, where audit logs live, and a customer-facing SDK flag to opt-out of auto-migration.
Alex R: launch gates we need: product sign-off on scope, legal contract language for pins, infra cost estimate, QA harness for benchmark automation, and customer comms template.
Maya P: action items: @Alex run cost delta by EOD, @Samir produce kernel/ops estimate by Tue, @Irene draft adoptability criteria doc and migration playbook, @Jose propose contract language & credits.
Samir K: quick Q — do we allow partial pins (i.e., pin embeddings only) or must it be whole-model? partial could reduce cost.
Maya P: partial pins allowed if customer agrees; must be explicit in contract. fallback policy: after TTL, automatic routing to latest-compatible variant unless customer extended pin.
Jose M: I'll push for a pilot: ACME takes 6mo extended pin at a discounted rate + 20% migration credits. If OK, we can bundle as a named enterprise SKU.
Irene L: I'll scaffold the adoptability doc and include template comms + migration checklist. will share draft link.
Alex R: noted. I'll include infra delta and estimate incremental monthly cost per pinned model.
release-bot: Created doc: /docs/catalog/adoptability-criteria/drafts/2501234567-acme-pilot.md
Maya P: thanks everyone. if no objections, I'll fold these items into the Q2 catalog roadmap and add the ACME pilot as a customer-driven experiment. :thumbsup:
Alex R: :thumbsup:
Samir K: on it.
Irene L: drafting now.
Jose M: negotiating terms with ACME tomorrow.
